name: autoveille
description: Veille d'annonces automobiles avec messages personnalisés prêts à envoyer

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/server', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('src/infrastructure/persistence/sqlite/migrations', 'dist/server/infrastructure/persistence/sqlite/migrations', { recursive: true })" && vite build
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.sw.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/client/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run test
